evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps straight into probing without framing the call length or the promise of a dependable quote. Opens with 'I'm actually calling because we received the request for an estimate for your move on October 10th. Is this a good time to talk about the mo?' — no time-box or wait.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' Instead went directly to property details after one passing check: 'do you have any concerns about the moving process' — generic throwaway, customer said 'No, not necessarily' and rep moved on without probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised no substantive concerns, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covered: property type (duplex), square footage (1100), stories (2), bedrooms (2 at pickup, 3 at dropoff), walking distance/truck access (driveway with parking), garage details (1-car, full of boxes + couch/coffee table/work table), patio furniture (2 chairs, 1 small table, 1 long wooden bench). All seven categories touched.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'I believe for a house your size we see 35 to 45 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' Customer confirmed 'Yeah, that's probably about right. If not, less.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor provided: '$1,100 square feet, we finish the move-in six hours' as typical + personalization: 'you are coming from a two story house, going to another two story house that is about three miles away. I will estimate the move to finish in five and a half to six and a half hours with two movers and one truck estimated cost is $1,221 to 1443.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep disclosed hourly rate ($111/mover, $222 for two), what's included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), and the 2.5-hour minimum + 15-minute-increment framing. Missing: no trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials fees mentioned (though packing was never offered, so unclear if applicable). No explicit 'not a guess' framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Customer asked 'Is there any way you could send like a, a copy of that to my email?' and rep responded directly, pivoting to deposit/cancellation policy and the booking ask — no 'Does that feel fair?' checkpoint.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep never delivered the Two Promises section, so no loop to close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. After booking confirmation, rep moved straight to the confirmation email and sign-off with no 'What's still concerning you?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never explicitly asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Instead rep pivoted to deposit/cancellation framing and then said 'would you like to secure your schedule for October 10th Saturday?' — which is conditional on prior acceptance but doesn't constitute a clear, upfront business ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes: 'if we're going to reserve this, there is not any deposit required we do not have any cancellation policy so no fees if they're gonna cancel or reschedule' — rate lock/no deposit mentioned in the context of reserving.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (October 10th Saturday), arrival window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), addresses (3001 West Lauder, 708 Decker Privy Drive, both repeated correctly). Missing: phone number confirmation not documented in transcript, crew size mentioned (2 movers, 1 truck) but not explicitly confirmed with customer, no notes left for crew about customer concerns (though customer raised none substantively).

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details across both pickup and dropoff locations, probing garage contents, patio furniture, and special items methodically, which builds an accurate move profile.
coaching_note: Critical gap: skip the 'Quid Pro quo' framing entirely, dive straight into probing, and never deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee, Damage Coverage) or ask for the business explicitly — you booked the move but didn't actually close on the value prop or ask for it.
